Furniture

The Ferm Living line of furniture is carefully designed and crafted within the Danish design tradition. Made of the most natural and honest materials, we produced them with love for simplicity, so our furniture is beautifully minimalistic, yet created for you to use every day. Our collection of furniture features tables, sofas, chairs, and shelving systems.

Ferm Living Tables and Chairs

Each room has its peculiarities, and so, each different room needs a different table. With the Mingle series of table-top and trestles, you can create a table in the exact colour combination that fits the space. The result is a balanced table that will work both as a contemporary dining table as well as a colourful desk.

The customised Mingle table will look its best when combined with chairs or stools from the Herman series. The Herman Chair is a lightweight design with an oval-shaped seat as well as a curved backrest for support and comfort. As a fine detail, we designed the angles of the armrest, so the chairs can be hung on the table when you need a little more floor space. The Herman series also includes the simple, stackable stool for when you need an extra seat.

Punctual Shelving System

Punctual is a high-quality shelving system from Ferm Living. It's a shelving system made from an idea that a modular system should be easily expanded to grow with your home and needs.

The basic structure of the Punctual Shelving System is robust with a clear reference to industrial shelving systems. Punctual can be used as a bookcase or kitchen rack, in your wardrobe or garden to hold everything from shoes to plants. Select the Punctual elements you need ? you can always add on more elements when you need it, or separate them into smaller shelves.

Turn sofa and daybed

Our Turn Series is classic Danish design furniture with a distinctive Ferm Living touch. Both the Turn sofas and daybeds are available in different materials and several colour combinations. The top cushion in both designs is reversible and dual-coloured, so you can turn it around to change the look in a flash.

The Turn sofa will be a natural gathering point for in your living room just as the daybed will catch the eye in a hallway or wherever you use it.

Combine the design furniture with the cluster tables that nested together will serve as a stylish coffee table or as a nice detail when you use the three tables separately in different spaces in your home.
